problems.reason: Both sentences state that Pisanosaurus was about 1 meter long.
Sentence 9 claims Pisanosaurus is the earliest primitive ornithischian, while sentences 10 and 13 state it is a silesaurid (non‑dinosaurian).
Sentence 3 refers to “reconstructions” without any prior mention of them.
